9700.name: Banner-Reaver war-chief
9700.long_desc: A Banner-Reaver war-chief stands here, a scorched strip of a great banner knotted at his belt.
9700.description:
A slab of a man in blackened mail, his helm crested with the torn pennants of the knights he has killed.
A strip of heavy cloth, gold thread on crimson, is knotted at his belt like a trophy.

9701.name: ember shade
9701.long_desc: An ember shade drifts here, a core of living fire beating in its chest of ash.
9701.description:
A shape of grey ash and smoke that only remembers being a person. Where its heart should be, a
core of ember glows and dims, glows and dims.

9702.name: Cinder Smith
9702.long_desc: The Cinder Smith hammers at a forge of white-hot slag, sparks crawling over his scorched leather apron.
9702.description:
Half man, half clinker, the Cinder Smith works the oldest forge in the Ashlands. Cracks of orange light
run through his skin wherever it bends, and his hammer is as long as you are tall.

phases.message: The Cinder Smith plunges his arm into the forge — his hammer comes out glowing white!

abilities.name: Hammerfall
abilities.telegraph: The Cinder Smith raises his hammer high over his head — the air shimmers with heat!

abilities.name: Slag Wave
abilities.telegraph: The Cinder Smith kicks over the forge — a wave of molten slag rolls outward!

9703.name: ashen drakeling
9703.long_desc: An ashen drakeling crouches here, wings of cinder half spread, smoke curling from its jaws.
9703.description: A young drake the colour of old ash, no larger than a pony, with eyes like coals.

9704.name: Reaver siegeman
9704.long_desc: A Banner-Reaver siegeman is here, ladder-hook in one hand and axe in the other.
9704.description:
One of the besiegers of the Last Bastion, soot-blackened and grinning, a long iron ladder-hook
slung over his shoulder.

9705.name: siege hound
9705.long_desc: A siege hound strains forward here, its spiked collar dragging a broken chain.
9705.description: A huge, scarred war-hound in a collar of iron spikes, bred to run down men in the smoke of a siege.

9706.name: Gorrund the Siegebreaker
9706.long_desc: Gorrund the Siegebreaker looms here, a ram-headed maul resting on one shoulder.
9706.description:
The warlord who broke the Last Bastion. Gorrund is a head taller than any man, armoured in plates
hammered from the gates of the cities he has taken, and his maul is the head of a battering ram.

phases.message: Gorrund bellows for his hounds!
Gorrund roars — the walls of the keep shake and dust rains from the rafters!

abilities.name: Rampart Crush
abilities.telegraph: Gorrund heaves his maul overhead — he is about to bring the floor down around him!

abilities.name: Siege Charge
abilities.telegraph: Gorrund lowers his head and paws the ground like a bull — he is going to charge!
abilities.on_success_message: Gorrund thunders through, scattering everything in his path!

9707.name: Banner-Reaver thrall
9707.long_desc: A Banner-Reaver thrall hovers at its war-chief's back, chained to him at the wrist.
9707.description: A captive turned fighter, chained to the war-chief he serves and ready to die for him.

9710.name: rift-warden
9710.long_desc: A rift-warden stands guard here, its armour stitched together from shards of other worlds.
9710.description:
A tall figure in plate that does not fit together: a pauldron from one world, a gauntlet from another,
all bound with threads of violet light. Where its face should be, a small black star turns slowly.

9711.name: arcane wraith
9711.long_desc: An arcane wraith drifts here, its body veined with glowing star-glass.
9711.description:
The ghost of an apprentice who read one page too far. Shards of star-glass are lodged in it like
splinters, and they glow brighter when it is angry.

9712.name: Echo of the Archmage
9712.long_desc: The Echo of the Archmage paces here, muttering the last spell she ever cast.
9712.description:
A woman made of lamplight and old ink, flickering like a bad candle. She was the mage who folded the
world shut; this is what was left behind when the fold closed.

phases.message: The Echo splits in two — and both halves keep casting!

abilities.name: Arcane Torrent
abilities.telegraph: The Echo draws a long breath of violet light — a torrent is coming!

abilities.name: Mirror Storm
abilities.telegraph: The air fills with spinning mirrors of force around the Echo!

9713.name: void spawn
9713.long_desc: A void spawn claws at the edges of the world here, all teeth and absence.
9713.description: A thing that fell in from the space between stars: a mouth with a body attached as an afterthought.

9714.name: star-wrought sentinel
9714.long_desc: A star-wrought sentinel grinds forward here, rings of brass turning in its chest.
9714.description:
A construct of orrery brass and starlight, built to keep the dying star company and to keep everything
else away from it.

9715.name: gravity mote
9715.long_desc: A gravity mote spins here, dragging dust and light into itself.
9715.description: A knot of collapsed space no bigger than a fist, and heavier than a house.

9716.name: Vaelith the Star-Eater
9716.long_desc: Vaelith the Star-Eater coils around the dying star here, drinking its light.
9716.description:
A serpent of night with a woman's face, long enough to wrap a sun three times. Her scales are the
black between the stars, and her eyes are two stars she has not finished eating.

phases.message: Vaelith tightens her coils — the star shudders and spits gravity motes!
Vaelith screams, and the star begins to collapse in earnest!

abilities.name: Event Horizon
abilities.telegraph: Vaelith opens her jaws and the light around her bends inward — the horizon is closing!

abilities.name: Starfall
abilities.telegraph: Vaelith lifts her head toward the star — a shard of it is about to fall on you!
abilities.on_success_message: A shard of the dying star crashes down, shattering the floor!

9717.name: void mote
9717.long_desc: A void mote orbits its rift-warden here like a small dark moon.
9717.description: A pebble of nothing, tethered to the warden it serves.

9720.name: drowned zealot
9720.long_desc: A drowned zealot raves here, water pouring from its mouth with every word.
9720.description:
A priest of Nereus who would not stop praying when the sea came in, and has not stopped since. Its
vestments are kelp and its rosary is barnacles.

9721.name: gilded harpy
9721.long_desc: A gilded harpy preens here, a stolen golden feather in its claws.
9721.description:
A harpy with gold leaf beaten into its feathers by some mad priest. It clutches a feather far brighter
than its own, and it will not let go.

9722.name: Gilded Hierophant
9722.long_desc: The Gilded Hierophant stands here before a cage of golden bars, chanting.
9722.description:
A priest-king in a mask of beaten gold, robed in cloth-of-gold gone green with age. Inside the cage
behind him something small and bright is singing.

phases.message: The Hierophant rattles the cage and his harpies come screaming!

abilities.name: Searing Censure
abilities.telegraph: The Hierophant raises a golden censer that blazes white-hot!

abilities.name: Gilded Wrath
abilities.telegraph: Gold dust swirls up around the Hierophant — it is about to ignite!

9723.name: hollow chorister
9723.long_desc: A hollow chorister sways here, singing a hymn with no words and no breath.
9723.description: One of the lost choir, emptied out and filled with silence. Its open mouth makes no sound at all.

9724.name: ashen acolyte
9724.long_desc: An ashen acolyte stands here, its mouth sewn shut with silver thread.
9724.description:
A novice of the choir, burned to ash and set back on its feet. The silver thread through its lips
glints when it moves.

9725.name: mourning wisp
9725.long_desc: A mourning wisp flickers here, sobbing a hymn backwards.
9725.description: A last breath of the choir, caught and soured into something that hurts to hear.

9726.name: Serathiel the Fallen
9726.long_desc: Serathiel the Fallen looms over the empty choir here, wings of black glass folded.
9726.description:
A seraph that fell: six wings of black glass, a body of cooling light, and where its face was, only a
mouth. It silenced the choir that called it, so that it would never have to answer again.

phases.message: Serathiel opens its mouth, and mourning wisps pour out!
Serathiel shrieks — the black glass of its wings begins to crack!

abilities.name: Wrath of the Fallen
abilities.telegraph: Serathiel spreads its six black wings — the light around it gathers to burst!

abilities.name: Severing Light
abilities.telegraph: Serathiel turns its mouth toward you; a needle of black light gathers there!
abilities.on_success_message: A needle of black light lances through the cathedral!

9727.name: zealot penitent
9727.long_desc: A penitent follows its zealot here, flagellating itself with a rope of kelp.
9727.description: A lesser drowned, bound to its zealot by guilt and seaweed.

9728.name: drowned priestess
9728.long_desc: The drowned priestess of the lost choir kneels here, singing under her breath.
9728.description:
A woman in the white of the choir, her hair floating as if she were still underwater. When she sings,
the water in the room answers.

talk_responses.hello: The priestess's voice is the sound of water in a bell. 'Speak, if you came to listen.'
talk_responses.default: The drowned priestess hums a few notes of a hymn you almost know.

9750.name: eclipse knight
9750.long_desc: An eclipse knight stands vigil here, a black sun on its shield.
9750.description:
A knight of the order who swore to the Eclipse instead. Its armour is black enamel over bone, and the
sun on its shield is a hole that light falls into.

9751.name: ember wisp
9751.long_desc: An ember wisp dances here, a spark of the first dawn at its heart.
9751.description: A drifting flame no bigger than a hand. Somewhere inside it burns a light older than the Ashlands.

9752.name: Ashen Templar
9752.long_desc: The Ashen Templar strides here, snuffing every spark it finds.
9752.description:
A templar of the Eclipse in armour of compressed ash, its sword a bar of cold black iron. Wherever it
walks, embers die.

phases.message: The Templar plunges its blade into the ash — a wisp tears free!

abilities.name: Ashen Brand
abilities.telegraph: The Templar lifts its black blade and the embers around it gutter out!

abilities.name: Smoulder
abilities.telegraph: Choking ash billows up around the Templar!

9753.name: shade of the eclipse
9753.long_desc: A shade of the eclipse slides here across the ground, a shadow without anything to cast it.
9753.description: A shadow that came loose from the world on the day the sun went out, and has hated light ever since.

9754.name: dawnless zealot
9754.long_desc: A dawnless zealot stands here, eyes sewn shut against the light.
9754.description: One of the Eclipse's faithful, who put out its own eyes so as never to see the dawn again.

9755.name: eclipse shade
9755.long_desc: An eclipse shade pours down the chapel wall here like spilled ink.
9755.description: A lesser shadow of the Eclipse, all reaching hands.

9756.name: Morvane the Eclipsed
9756.long_desc: Morvane the Eclipsed stands before the altar here, a black sun burning in his chest.
9756.description:
Once the order's brightest knight; now its darkest. Morvane wears the order's armour still, but a black
sun burns where his heart was, and the light bends away from him.

phases.message: Morvane calls, and the dead of the chapel answer!
Morvane roars — the black sun flares and the chapel goes dark!

abilities.name: Black Sun
abilities.telegraph: The black sun in Morvane's chest swells — it is about to burst!

abilities.name: Eclipse Lance
abilities.telegraph: Morvane levels a lance of black light at you!
abilities.on_success_message: The eclipse lance tears through the chapel!

9757.name: eclipse squire
9757.long_desc: An eclipse squire hovers at its knight's side here, sword half drawn.
9757.description: A young squire who followed its master into the dark.

9760.name: bone colossus
9760.long_desc: A bone colossus looms here, a library of ribs and pages.
9760.description:
A giant built from the bones of a hundred scholars, its ribcage stuffed with the pages they wrote. It
guards the words of the First Lich with everything it is made of.

9761.name: wailing shade
9761.long_desc: A wailing shade drifts here, clutching a shard of green fire to its chest.
9761.description: A ghost that caught a splinter of a stolen soul and cannot let it go, and cannot stop screaming.

9762.name: Soulbinder
9762.long_desc: The Soulbinder stands here amid a web of chains, each one ending in a screaming light.
9762.description:
A gaunt sorcerer of the Shadowspire who collects souls the way others collect coins. Chains of dark iron
hang from its wrists, and every one of them ends in a soul.

phases.message: The Soulbinder looses a chain — a shade tears free of it!

abilities.name: Soul Chains
abilities.telegraph: The Soulbinder whirls a chain of screaming souls over its head!

abilities.name: Wail of the Bound
abilities.telegraph: Every soul on the Soulbinder's chains draws breath to scream!

9763.name: jealous dead
9763.long_desc: One of the jealous dead claws its way toward the jar here.
9763.description: A corpse of the Necropolis that heard a soul calling and wants it for itself.

9764.name: phylactery warden
9764.long_desc: A phylactery warden stands here, a jar of green fire set into its chest.
9764.description: A servant of Xal'thar with a lesser jar where its heart was. It will not die while the jar is whole.

9765.name: bound servant
9765.long_desc: A bound servant crawls here, its soul still glowing in a cracked jar on its back.
9765.description: One of the First Lich's servants, its soul kept in a jar it carries like a snail carries a shell.

9766.name: Xal'thar the First Lich
9766.long_desc: Xal'thar the First Lich sits here on a throne of jars, grave-fire guttering in his skull.
9766.description:
The first to put his soul in a jar and walk on without it. Xal'thar is little more than a crown, a robe
and a skull now, but the grave-fire in his sockets has not dimmed in a thousand years.

phases.message: Xal'thar cracks a jar, and its servant crawls free!
Xal'thar laughs — and every jar in the vault begins to crack!

abilities.name: Death's Embrace
abilities.telegraph: Xal'thar spreads his arms and the grave-fire swells around him!

abilities.name: Soul Rend
abilities.telegraph: Xal'thar reaches for your soul with a hand of green fire!
abilities.on_success_message: Xal'thar's grave-fire tears through flesh and spirit alike!

9767.name: bone shard swarm
9767.long_desc: A swarm of bone shards whirls around its colossus here.
9767.description: Splinters of the colossus, loose and angry.

9731.name: tomb warden
9731.long_desc: A tomb warden stands its endless watch here, a ring of bronze keys at its belt.
9731.description:
A mummified guard of the Pyramid, wrapped in linen gone black with age. A ring of bronze keys hangs at
its hip, and it still remembers which door each one opens.

9732.name: Keeper of Keys
9732.long_desc: The Keeper of Keys sits here on a throne of locked chests, jingling softly.
9732.description:
A jackal-headed guardian draped in a mantle of a thousand keys. Every vault in the Pyramid answers to it,
and it has never once been robbed.

phases.message: The Keeper rattles its mantle — a tomb warden lurches out of the dark!

abilities.name: Key-Lash
abilities.telegraph: The Keeper swings its mantle of keys back like a flail!

abilities.name: Lockdown
abilities.telegraph: Bronze bars grind up out of the floor around the Keeper!

9733.name: vault sentinel
9733.long_desc: A vault sentinel clanks forward here, its chest a strongbox with teeth.
9733.description:
A guardian of brass and coral built by the priests of Nereus to keep their treasure — and the thieves who
came for it.

9734.name: gilded guard
9734.long_desc: A gilded guard stands here, polishing a halberd that is worth more than you are.
9734.description: A guard of the Vault of Ages in armour of beaten gold, paid in coin he will never be allowed to spend.

9735.name: ledger wisp
9735.long_desc: A ledger wisp flutters here, a page of accounts burning with cold fire.
9735.description: A page torn from the Auditor's ledger, still adding up debts that will never be paid.

9736.name: Auditor Mordessa
9736.long_desc: Auditor Mordessa sits here behind a desk piled with ledgers, quill scratching.
9736.description:
The keeper of the Vault of Ages: a gaunt woman in ink-black robes whose eyes are two gold coins. Every
theft that was ever planned against her vault is written in her ledger — and every thief's fate.

phases.message: Mordessa tears a page from her ledger — it bursts into a wisp of cold fire!
Mordessa screams for the guard — the vault doors begin to grind shut!

abilities.name: Final Accounting
abilities.telegraph: Mordessa slams her ledger shut — the vault itself is about to collect!

abilities.name: Debt Called In
abilities.telegraph: Mordessa points her quill at you and reads out what you owe!
abilities.on_success_message: Your debt is called in — in blood!

9740.name: dire alpha
9740.long_desc: A dire alpha stands over its kill here, hackles raised, eyes the colour of old ice.
9740.description:
The leader of a pack that has hunted the Northern Forest since before the trappers came: a wolf the size
of a horse, scarred, grey at the muzzle, and smarter than any hunter that has tried for it.

9741.name: cliff roc
9741.long_desc: A cliff roc perches here, storm-grey feathers ruffling in the sea wind.
9741.description:
A great raptor of the coastal cliffs whose long flight feathers carry the charge of every storm it has
flown through.

9742.name: Roc Matriarch
9742.long_desc: The Roc Matriarch looms over her nest here, wings mantled against the wind.
9742.description:
The oldest of the cliff rocs, her wingspan wider than a ship is long, lightning crackling in her plumage.
No arrow has ever brought her down.

phases.message: The Matriarch screams, and a cliff roc dives to her side!

abilities.name: Talon Dive
abilities.telegraph: The Matriarch rises high on the wind — she is about to dive on you!

abilities.name: Stormwing
abilities.telegraph: The Matriarch spreads her wings and the air crackles with lightning!

9743.name: wyvern broodling
9743.long_desc: A wyvern broodling hisses here, its tail-sting dripping.
9743.description: A young wyvern of Gloomfang's brood, all hunger and venom.

9744.name: thorn-stalker
9744.long_desc: A thorn-stalker crouches in the bramble here, its hide grown through with thorns.
9744.description: A great cat that has lived so long in the briars that the briars have started living in it.

9745.name: wyvern hatchling
9745.long_desc: A wyvern hatchling flaps clumsily here, shrieking for its mother.
9745.description: A wyvern fresh from the egg, already venomous, already hungry.

9746.name: Gloomfang, the Last Wyvern
9746.long_desc: Gloomfang, the Last Wyvern, coils on her nest of bones here, watching you with one huge eye.
9746.description:
The last of the great wyverns: forty feet of storm-black scale and venom, her wings tattered from a
thousand hunters' arrows. Every hunter of the guild has a tale of her. None has a trophy.

phases.message: Gloomfang shrieks, and a hatchling bursts from an egg on the nest!
Gloomfang roars and takes to the air, wings blotting out the sky!

abilities.name: Tail Sweep
abilities.telegraph: Gloomfang coils her great tail — it is about to sweep the whole nest!

abilities.name: Venom Dive
abilities.telegraph: Gloomfang rears back, venom dripping from her sting — she is going to strike!

9747.name: dire wolf
9747.long_desc: A dire wolf circles its alpha here, teeth bared.
9747.description: One of the alpha's pack: big, grey and very hungry.

9771.name: chime automaton
9771.long_desc: A chime automaton ticks here, bells ringing in its hollow chest.
9771.description:
A clockwork musician of the Foundry, built to play one song forever. The gears in its chest still hum the
opening bars of something old.

9772.name: Carillon Engine
9772.long_desc: The Carillon Engine towers here, a cathedral of bells on brass legs.
9772.description:
A walking bell-tower of the Clockwork Foundry, its hundred bells tuned to a song nobody has heard in a
thousand years — and the gears that remember it.

phases.message: The Engine rings out of tune — a chime automaton clatters to life!

abilities.name: Great Bell
abilities.telegraph: The Carillon Engine swings its greatest bell back on its chains!

abilities.name: Discord Peal
abilities.telegraph: Every bell on the Engine shudders at once — a deafening peal is coming!

9773.name: chaos discord
9773.long_desc: A chaos discord shrieks here, a knot of noise that hurts to look at.
9773.description: A thing of pure wrong notes, born where the elements clash and drawn to any song it can ruin.

9774.name: hollow courtier
9774.long_desc: A hollow courtier bows here, its mouth a smooth blank.
9774.description: A courtier of the Unsung King, its face wiped clean of mouth and voice when the song was forgotten.

9775.name: silent echo
9775.long_desc: A silent echo shivers here, the shape of a sound with none left in it.
9775.description: What is left of a verse when nobody sings it any more.

9776.name: Mute King
9776.long_desc: The Mute King sits here on a throne of silent bells, crowned in stopped clocks.
9776.description:
The last of the Unsung Kings, whose name the song was written to remember. When the world forgot the song
it forgot him too, and he has hated every singer since.

phases.message: The Mute King lifts a hand and an echo answers the silence!
The Mute King rises — and for the first time in a thousand years, he screams!

abilities.name: Silence
abilities.telegraph: The Mute King spreads his hands and all sound drains from the hall!

abilities.name: Discord
abilities.telegraph: The Mute King points at you — the wrongest note there is gathers in his fist!
abilities.on_success_message: The wrong note tears through you!

9780.name: mirror-blade
9780.long_desc: A mirror-blade watches you here in a coat of silvered glass — one of the three names on your contract.
9780.description:
A killer of the Shadowspire whose coat is sewn with shards of mirror, so that anyone who looks at them sees
only themselves. There is a price on this head, and the price is yours.

9781.name: cutthroat
9781.long_desc: A cutthroat lounges here, a pouch of black lotus at their belt.
9781.description: A smuggler of the Sunken Coast, dealing in the black lotus that the Poisoner buys by the bale.

9782.name: Poisoner
9782.long_desc: The Poisoner stirs a bubbling cauldron here, humming.
9782.description:
A small, soft-spoken man in an apron stained every colour there is. He has killed more people than plague,
and he has never once had to touch them.

phases.message: The Poisoner whistles, and a cutthroat steps out of the shadows!

abilities.name: Venom Flask
abilities.telegraph: The Poisoner draws back his arm, a flask of green venom in his fist!

abilities.name: Miasma
abilities.telegraph: The Poisoner kicks his cauldron over — a cloud of poison rolls out!

9783.name: mark's bodyguard
9783.long_desc: A mark's bodyguard stalks here, searching every shadow.
9783.description: A sworn guard of the marks you killed, come looking for whoever did it.

9784.name: glass sentinel
9784.long_desc: A glass sentinel stands here, reflecting everything and showing nothing.
9784.description: A guardian of mirrored glass in the shape of a knight. You can see yourself in it, a dozen times over.

9785.name: reflection
9785.long_desc: A reflection of you steps out of a mirror here and smiles.
9785.description: You, but wrong: the face is a little too smooth, the smile a little too wide.

9786.name: Faceless One
9786.long_desc: The Faceless One stands here among the mirrors, wearing a face it took from someone else.
9786.description:
The guild's oldest contract: the assassin who killed so many that it forgot its own face, and has been
wearing other people's ever since. Tonight it is wearing yours.

phases.message: The Faceless One steps into a mirror — and a reflection steps out!
The Faceless One takes off its stolen face — there is nothing underneath!

abilities.name: Shatter
abilities.telegraph: Every mirror in the hall cracks at once — the shards are about to fly!

abilities.name: Mirror Blade
abilities.telegraph: The Faceless One draws a blade of mirrored glass and fixes your face in it!
abilities.on_success_message: The mirror blade finds you through your own reflection!

9787.name: sworn blade
9787.long_desc: A sworn blade guards its master here, steel already drawn.
9787.description: A bodyguard bound by oath to the mark it protects.

9788.name: veiled informant
9788.long_desc: A veiled informant waits here in the shadow of a pillar.
9788.description: A figure in grey veils whose voice changes every time it speaks. It sells names to the guild.

talk_responses.hello: The informant's voice is a woman's, then an old man's. 'You came for the names. Good.'
talk_responses.default: The veiled informant says nothing at all, very carefully.
